chapter_seo_title: Five Hundred Years of Hell: Xiao Chen Ascends to Half-Ancestor
chapter_meta_description: After 500 years of body destruction and rebirth, Xiao Chen ascends to the Half-Ancestor realm, absorbing lightning from all worlds and mastering 30 War Swords. Attacks from legendary weapons test his newfound power.
og_description: 500 years of suffering yield transcendent power. Xiao Chen breaks into the Half-Ancestor realm, wielding thirty War Swords with a broken array as legendary weapons attack.
twitter_title: Xiao Chen Reaches Half-Ancestor After 500 Years
twitter_description: Body shattering, lightning absorption, and War Sword mastery—Xiao Chen ascends, only to face the Immortal Shield, Demon Blade, and a thirty-three-layered pagoda.
